astraservicespartners-astraservicespartn.title: Service Coordinator
astraservicespartners-astraservicespartn.description: Service Coordinator Join the APCCO team, an Astra business, as a Service Coordinator, where you'll play a central role in keeping our field service operations running smoothly. This is a great opportunity to build a career in a specialized and essential industry with a team that values collaboration and professional growth. What You'll Do: Coordinate day-to-day scheduling for Service Technicians, managing communication between customers, technicians, and internal team members to keep everyone informed and on track Support ongoing customer needs by maintaining preventative maintenance contracts, coordinating repair estimates, ordering parts, scheduling work, and processing customer billing Maintain customer documentation in compliance with ammonia refrigeration regulations based on geographic requirements Contribute to a collaborative, positive, and professional team environment Role Structure: You'll be primarily focused in one of three areas while cross-trained to support all functions as business needs arise: Tech Dispatch / Customer Interaction Service Quotes Parts Ordering & Inventory Compensation: $50,000 – $60,000 annually We offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage, a 401(k) with up to 5% company match, and a variety of supplemental benefits available to fit your needs. Locations: Fresno, CA | Modesto, CA Schedule: Monday–Friday, standard business hours, with some on-call availability.

casdincapital-casdin-capital:ashbyhq:fb0.title: Business Development Director
casdincapital-casdin-capital:ashbyhq:fb0.description: Firm Overview Casdin Capital, LLC (“Casdin”) is a New York-based fundamental research investment firm focused on the life sciences and healthcare industry. The firm manages a long-short equity fund and invests in early- to late-stage private investments. Casdin was launched in 2012 by founder and CIO Eli Casdin and manages a multi-billion dollar fund. At Casdin, we start from a position of curiosity, honesty, and passion for gaining a deep and thoughtful understanding of opportunities in the life science ecosystem. We commit to finding the highest quality management teams doing the work to create high-growth companies. We use data to continually advance our knowledge and are long-term investors. We believe in collaboration and transparency and operate at the forefront of innovation. Position Overview We offer the ideal candidate an opportunity to significantly impact our AUM and revenue targets. The focus will be on executing a successful fundraising strategy and marketing our product offerings to new and existing investors, expanding the Casdin network over the long run. The ideal candidate has a relentless drive, top-of-the-charts EQ, and is deeply process-driven with a collaborative approach. Responsibilities -Develop and execute a go-to-market plan, focusing on marketing our product offerings to new and existing investors in family offices, endowments, and foundations. -Prospect and develop new relationships with potential investors, using a hunter mindset to focus efforts on the highest opportunities for medium—and long-term investor relationships that align with Casdin’s investment objectives. -Keep a pulse on the market, capture thoughtful market feedback to support our product development strategy, and document all feedback in a CRM/knowledge database. -Create and organize marketing campaigns and collateral, providing insights that can be additive to investor-facing marketing materials. -Play an active role in the execution of investor-facing materials by incorporating market feedback and leveraging internal data and research to support the Casdin narrative. -Work in close partnership with Research, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver high-quality client service to Casdin Limited partners. -Organize communications to ensure key decision-makers attend client meetings with organized follow-ups documented in the CRM. -Organize, attend, and manage the execution of client-facing meetings, coordinating closely with administrative and operational colleagues to ensure the team has appropriate materials to present, travel arrangements are confirmed, and the team has all of the pertinent information about the client. Requirements/Qualifications -Preferred candidates will have 5-10+ years of experience and a track record of success selling hedge fund and private investment products to family offices, endowments, foundations, pensions, and consultants. -Relentless drive to meet fundraising demands while handling competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. -Superb written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft engaging and influential messages for investors, marketing collateral to support investor pitch materials, and regular investor relations touch points. -Researcher's mentality to discover value in the preparation of digging into a network and identifying connections to leverage introductions to new client prospects. -Process-driven & detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills to manage each step of the process with an outcome-oriented and collaborative approach. -Ability to work independently and diligently – can develop a clear ask for what analysis is required to support investor discussions and work with subject matter experts throughout the firm to compile relevant components. -Deeply organized and efficient in supporting client meetings and marketing events execution. -Appreciates the value and owns the process of relationship tracking within the CRM. compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.title: Sterile Processing Technician
compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Location: Middleburg Surgery Center Address: 1821 Blanding Blvd. Suite 1, Middleburg, FL 32068 Middleburg Surgery Center is a modern, multi-specialty ambulatory surgery center located in Middleburg, Florida, delivering high-quality outpatient care across orthopedics, pain management, ENT, podiatry, and plastic surgery. Our team is committed to providing safe, compassionate, and efficient surgical experiences. The center is in an exciting phase of strategic growth, expanding both services and specialties. We are building a collaborative, high-performance environment that values clinical excellence, operational innovation, and continuous improvement. Whether clinical or administrative, every role at Middleburg plays a vital part in our mission. We offer team members the opportunity to grow professionally within a forward-thinking ASC model, with potential for leadership, development, and future physician alignment or investment opportunities. Ideal candidates are motivated, patient-focused, and eager to contribute to a dynamic, evolving healthcare setting. Role Summary: The Sterile Processing Technician is responsible for cleaning, sterilizing, assembling, and storing surgical instruments and equipment. This role ensures the operating team has the tools needed for safe, effective patient care, directly supporting the perioperative process and overall patient safety Hours: - Monday–Friday schedule, Full Time - No nights, weekends, holidays, or call What You’ll Do: - Clean, inspect, sterilize, and package instruments and equipment according to standards - Assemble instrument trays and maintain accurate labeling and storage - Operate sterilizers, washers, and related equipment safely and effectively - Monitor and maintain sterile supply inventory; check for outdated or compromised items - Support patient safety, infection prevention, and quality improvement initiatives - Communicate effectively with teammates, physicians, and other staff - Maintain a clean, orderly, and compliant sterile processing work area What You’ll Bring: - High school diploma or GED required - Prior experience in sterile processing required - CBSPD or IAHCSMM certification preferred (or ability to obtain within 18 months of hire if required) - Current BLS certification - Strong attention to detail, teamwork, and communication skills Physical & Work Environment Requirements: - Frequent standing, walking, and lifting - Occasional stooping, kneeling, or climbing - Ability to lift/move up to 50 lbs (occasionally up to 100 lbs) - Regular exposure to bloodborne pathogens, chemicals, and sterilization equipment in a fast-paced environment Compensation & Benefits: - Competitive hourly rate (based on experience and qualifications) - Healthcare benefits package - 401(k) with company match - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Supportive, collaborative, and growing environment

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4c15dc12-6755-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Property Management Account Manager based in Estonia. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take ownership of a diverse portfolio and its day-to-day operations. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for clients and tenants, building strong relationships while ensuring properties are managed efficiently. The role combines operational oversight, communication, team coordination, and independent problem-solving. You’ll be expected to navigate complex situations that may not have straightforward answers, using sound judgment and a proactive mindset. Starting with a portfolio of around 100 units, you’ll have the opportunity to scale toward 150, 200, or more units as your performance grows. It’s an ideal environment for an adaptable, resilient professional who thrives on responsibility, fast-paced work, and continuous improvement. Serve as the primary point of contact for client and tenant communications, managing relationships professionally and ensuring timely, effective responses. Oversee the day-to-day operations of an assigned property portfolio, maintaining high standards of service and operational performance. Manage a portfolio that may range from approximately 70 units for standard performers to 350 units for top performers. Handle daily communication workflows, primarily through written correspondence and email, with occasional outbound phone calls. Take ownership of portfolio growth, with an initial target of approximately 100 units and the opportunity to scale to 150, 200, or more units based on performance. Coordinate workflows and oversee team performance, including supervising, guiding, and holding Virtual Assistants accountable. Identify and resolve unusual or complex operational issues that may fall outside established procedures, manuals, or FAQs. Apply critical thinking, initiative, and sound judgment to determine appropriate solutions in ambiguous situations. De-escalate conflicts with clients and tenants calmly and professionally while maintaining positive relationships. Adapt quickly to changing priorities and operational demands while maintaining a high level of service and attention to detail. Requirements: Previous professional experience in property management, particularly as a Leasing Agent, Property Management Assistant, Property Manager, or in a comparable property operations position. Demonstrated ability to oversee daily property operations, workflows, and team performance. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence managing clients, tenants, and team members. Experience supervising, guiding, delegating to, and holding Virtual Assistants or remote team members accountable. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to make sound decisions when situations are complex or solutions are not explicitly documented. Highly adaptable and resourceful, with a proactive, self-directed, and autodidactic approach to learning and problem-solving. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment. Calm and professional approach to conflict resolution, with resilience and a consistently positive attitude. Availability to work U.S. business hours. A quiet, dedicated home-office environment suitable for professional calls and focused work. Reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps, with a backup internet connection available. Dependable electricity with a suitable power backup solution. Computer with at least an Intel Core i5 8th generation processor, AMD Ryzen 5, or equivalent. At least 8 GB of RAM, with 16 GB or more preferred. Windows 10 or higher or a compatible recent version of macOS. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f5a1c325-7662-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Funnels/Workflow based in Ireland. As Senior Product Manager, you will define the strategy and roadmap for two high-impact products focused on customer acquisition, monetization, and subscriber growth. You will lead the evolution of workflow automation and web-to-app conversion experiences that help developers turn subscriber behavior and web traffic into revenue. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, growth experimentation, analytics, UX, and highly technical infrastructure. You will work closely with engineering, design, data, go-to-market teams, customers, and senior leadership to identify opportunities and turn them into scalable products. A strong analytical mindset will be essential, with hands-on use of data and metrics to understand customer behavior and guide product decisions. You will also need enough technical depth to understand APIs, data models, system architecture, and complex product logic while collaborating independently with engineering teams. This is a high-ownership, remote-first opportunity where your work can directly influence how millions of end users discover, purchase, and engage with subscription products. Own the product strategy, vision, and roadmap for the Funnels and Workflows product areas. Define a cohesive product direction that prioritizes customer value, business impact, experimentation, and sustainable growth. Lead the development of Workflows as an orchestration engine for paywalls, win-back offers, lifecycle campaigns, and other experiences triggered by subscriber behavior. Drive the evolution of Funnels as a web-to-app product designed to convert web traffic into paying mobile subscribers. Engage directly with prospective and existing customers to understand use cases, uncover adoption barriers, identify feature gaps, and help customers improve monetization outcomes. Proactively investigate customer and product problems rather than relying entirely on engineering or support teams to identify and diagnose issues. Partner with growth teams and customers to understand their objectives, challenges, experimentation needs, and monetization strategies. Identify, prioritize, and develop product features that allow customers to create compelling experiences, measure outcomes, and iterate quickly. Establish robust product metrics and use quantitative analysis to evaluate adoption, conversion, retention, revenue impact, and overall product performance. Work closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams to translate product opportunities into scalable solutions and bring them successfully to market. Understand the technical infrastructure behind the products and make informed decisions about APIs, data models, system complexity, risk logic, and dependencies. Break ambitious product initiatives into meaningful, achievable increments with clear priorities and realistic timelines. Collaborate directly with senior leadership to communicate product opportunities, strategy, progress, trade-offs, and expected impact. Continuously experiment, learn from results, and refine product strategy based on customer feedback and data. Act as a strong advocate for customers while maintaining a clear focus on helping them increase revenue, conversion, and subscriber growth. Requirements 5+ years of experience in product management, technical product engineering, analytics, or a closely related discipline, with meaningful experience contributing to the growth of mobile applications. Strong analytical capabilities and significant experience working directly with data to inform product strategy and decision-making. Advanced proficiency in SQL or comparable analytical tools, with the ability and willingness to independently investigate data and uncover actionable insights. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fa2e80a0-2ab2-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Test Craftsperson/Automation based in United Kingdom. Join a remote-first engineering environment where software quality and craftsmanship are treated as core engineering disciplines. You’ll own testing across the full software development lifecycle, working alongside developers in a continuous deployment model. The role combines functional testing, automation, programming, infrastructure, and close collaboration with product teams and clients. You’ll build and evolve automation frameworks while using AI responsibly to make testing faster, smarter, and more effective. Your work will directly influence product stability, user experience, and the predictability of production releases. You’ll be encouraged to apply Agile, Extreme Programming, and DevOps practices while continuously developing your technical craft. This is an ideal opportunity for a quality-focused engineer who enjoys learning, collaboration, ownership, and solving complex problems with modern tools. Own end-to-end testing initiatives across the complete software development lifecycle within a continuous deployment environment. Plan and execute functional and automated testing, identify relevant test conditions, and develop comprehensive test scenarios. Build, maintain, and continuously improve test automation frameworks using modern technologies and engineering practices. Use AI tools responsibly to generate and improve test cases, explore edge cases, analyze bug patterns, create mock data, and accelerate documentation while maintaining human oversight and quality control. Develop and maintain automated test scripts, troubleshoot failures, and improve the reliability and maintainability of automation suites. Understand user behavior and act as the user's representative, helping ensure system stability, integrity, predictability, and safe deployment of new features and fixes. Work closely with Business Analysts and other stakeholders to understand the system, identify process improvements, contribute to user stories, understand product roadmaps, and support sprint planning. Collaborate closely with developers and other team members in a DevOps-oriented environment where engineering teams share ownership of the complete release cycle. Contribute to programming, cloud infrastructure, testing environments, and other technical areas as required by project needs. Apply software craftsmanship, Agile, and Extreme Programming principles to continuously improve testing practices and engineering quality. Continuously develop your technical and professional skills while sharing knowledge and contributing to stronger engineering practices across teams. Requirements: 3+ years of hands-on experience as an Automation QA Engineer, Test Engineer, Software Engineer in Test, or similar role. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and a genuine commitment to delivering high-quality, reliable products. Hands-on experience with Cypress or Playwright and JavaScript as a core programming language. Experience creating test automation frameworks from scratch and maintaining them as products and technologies evolve. Practical experience with Behavior Driven Development (BDD), including Cucumber and Gherkin. Solid understanding of object-oriented programming, software engineering principles, and web technologies such as HTML and jQuery. Ability to write SQL queries for data validation and troubleshoot testing environments using Linux commands. Experience maintaining or working with test servers and an interest in infrastructure and cloud technologies. Strong interest in DevOps practices and CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, Bamboo, or GitHub Actions. Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or specialized QA assistants to improve manual testing activities, including brainstorming edge cases, creating test cases, generating moc

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:d9b854.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:d9b854.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. As a Mid-Market Account Executive, you will lead fast-moving, consultative sales cycles with high-growth organizations. You will be instrumental in expanding Profound’s reach across the mid-market and help shape how we scale our go-to-market motion as the team grows. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own the entire mid-market sales cycle, from targeted prospecting to negotiation and close - Develop and execute scalable outreach strategies to drive new business and expand Profound’s footprint across the mid-market - Manage a high-velocity pipeline, balancing strategic conversations with efficient execution - Build and nurture relationships that turn first deals into long-term partnerships - Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to accelerate learnings and refine messaging WHO YOU ARE - A proven SaaS closer with experience selling into mid-market accounts and consistently exceeding quota - Skilled at running multiple deals in parallel and adapting your approach to fit a fast-moving sales environment - Entrepreneurial and hands-on, energized by building something new and driving early traction - Resilient, curious, and motivated by impact, with a strong bias toward action and experimentation LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our NYC, SF, Boston, or London office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $90,000 to $150,000 before commission (NYC and SF). Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring. Note: All official communication from Profound will come from a @tryprofound.com email address. If you're contacted by anyone using a different domain, please disregard and report it as spam.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:85827e35-320.title: Project Lion - Senior Prompt Engineer - Japan (Remote, Part-Time)
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:85827e35-320.description: We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance.
responsibilities: Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters.
Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus.

Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts.
Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked.
Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall.
Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final.
qualifications: Language Skills : Native fluency in Japanese and fluent in English.
Location:   Must be based in Japan.
Education : Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field.

Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise : At least 4 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning.
Data Analysis : Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools.
Technical Agility : Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision.
Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API.
Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering.
Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows.
Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic.
